name: wolf
about: A gray wolf: about 80 cm at the shoulder, long legs, a long muzzle, ears up, a thick tail that hangs down.
sources: A gray wolf (Canis lupus): 66 to 92 cm at the shoulder, 105 to 160 cm long without the tail.
The lengths of the fur (fur): a guess from photos of the animal, not a measurement.
